## Validation

List the exact commands and observed results. Include a synthetic failure example when fixing a bug. For UI changes, add desktop/mobile evidence with no private data.

## Risks and remaining limitations

- [ ] I reviewed the change and have the right to contribute it.
- [ ] I preserved third-party licenses and notices.
- [ ] I included no credentials, personal records or private target data.
- [ ] I updated relevant docs and meaningful tests.
- [ ] I disclosed material AI assistance and checked its output.

Security-sensitive reports should use the private route in SECURITY.md.
